params.prompt: Instructional how-to video about the TrailMaster X4, a four-person dome tent with a forest-green body and a burnt-orange rainfly. Clear, well-lit meadow in daylight, eye-level camera, hands and tent always in frame. Action: If your tent includes a rainfly, spread it over the tent body. Attach the rainfly to the tent corners and secure it with the provided buckles or clips. Adjust the tension of the rainfly to ensure proper airflow and weather protection. Audio: quiet outdoor ambience, no music, no speech.
